overclocks.nameEn: Careful tweaking has resulted in greater charge capacity as well as an increase in total capacity.
overclocks.effectZh: ▲ 小幅提升电池容量；▲ 提高电容容量
▲ 提升放电和充电速率；▲ 相当多的弹药；▼ 射击将持续至电容完全放电；▼ 降低电容容量

overclocks.nameEn: Ignite most enemies in one pass
overclocks.effectZh: ▲ 点燃路径内的大多数敌人；▼ 降低造成的伤害；▼ 降低对护甲造成的伤害

overclocks.nameEn: By passing an electric current through the plasma, the beam electrocutes anything it touches but the bulky hardware limits magazine capacity.
overclocks.effectZh: ▲ 使被命中的敌人触电；▼ 降低弹匣容量

overclocks.nameEn: Holding down the trigger after the line leaves the gun activates a remote connection which on the release of the trigger causes the line to change direction and move back towards the gun.
overclocks.effectZh: ▲ 松开开火按钮将使等离子线往反方向移动；▼ 降低备弹量

overclocks.nameEn: By improving the node's efficiency you can up the raw damage without too much fuss and it lasts a bit longer too!
overclocks.effectZh: ▲ 略微提升伤害；▼ 更长的发射物寿命

overclocks.nameEn: Bring more ammo with you and slam those cases in faster!
overclocks.effectZh: ▲ 更多弹药；▲ 更快的换弹速度

overclocks.nameEn: Beam spins and advances slowly, continuously dealing damage
overclocks.effectZh: ▲ 射线水平旋转并缓慢前进，持续造成伤害；▲ 延长等离子线持续时间和宽度；▼ 更低的射线伤害；▼ 极低的弹药和载弹量

overclocks.nameEn: A few tweaks to the launcher cause it to add roll to the projectile after it is ejected thus covering a larger area as it travels. Holding down the trigger as the line leaves the gun activates a remote connection which lets you steer the projectile as long as the trigger is held down. On the release of the trigger the connection is broken and the projectile continues in a straight line. The projectile is also able to travel further before collapsing.
overclocks.effectZh: ▼ 旋转的等离子射线飞行距离更长且覆盖范围更广；▲ 按住开火按钮可操控等离子射线转向

overclocks.nameEn: Automatic firing at locked targets. Fire Rate affected by Lock-On time.
overclocks.effectZh: ▲ “大聪明” 扳机系统™；▲ 自动射击已锁定的敌人，射击频率取决于锁定速率；▲ 显著提升锁定速率；▼ 降低最大锁定层数

overclocks.nameEn: Locked shots always hit their target and ignore armor
overclocks.effectZh: ▲ 锁定射击必定命中目标且无视护甲；▲ 提升锁定维持角度；▼ 降低射击速度；▼ 更长的换弹时间

overclocks.nameEn: Every enemy with 3 locks triggers an explosion on the last shot.
overclocks.effectZh: ▲ 使命中被锁定 3 层以上的目标的最后一发子弹爆炸；▼ 降低造成的伤害；▼ 降低备弹量
▲ 达到最大锁定上限时对护甲造成更高伤害
▲ 使被锁定的目标减速；▼ 限制锁定持续时间
▲ 在满锁定层数时显著增加弱点伤害；▲ 非常快的锁定速度；▼ 降低最大锁定层数；▼ 降低弹匣容量和备弹量

overclocks.nameEn: Clean up the caves with an expanded magazine combined with the ability to acquire more locks.
overclocks.effectZh: ▲ 增加最大锁定层数；▲ 提升弹匣容量
▲ 击中地形时布置强力地雷；▲ 地雷的伤害和爆炸范围更为优异；▼ 飞弹无制导功能；▼ 略微减少备弹量
▲ 飞弹会贯穿敌人；▲ 提升飞弹机动性；▼ 降低造成的伤害；▼ 降低备弹量
▲ 提高射速；▲ 提升飞弹最大速度
▲ 显著提高射速；▲ 相当多的弹药；▼ 飞弹无制导功能；▼ 更低的单发伤害

overclocks.nameEn: Grandpa's recipe. Highly unstable and heavy, but works like a charm! Your missiles get a much higher top speed and reach it instantly. The extra energy greatly improves direct damage but all that extra fuel reduces the missile payload capacity. Due to the extra weight both magazine and total ammo capacity are also reduced.
overclocks.effectZh: ▲ 飞弹射出后瞬间开始提速且可达到更高速度；▲ 显著增加直接伤害；▼ 爆炸的范围和伤害减少；▼ 降低弹匣容量和备弹量
▲ 按住换弹键可以使飞弹释放小型炸弹；▲ 显著提升伤害；▼ 低速发射物；▼ 降低弹匣容量和备弹量
▲ 略微增大作用范围；▲ 略微提高范围伤害

overclocks.nameEn: Enables your weapon to load up to 9 missiles and launch them at once! As an added bonus the overloaded exhaust ports increase missile velocity and boost damage based on how many missiles are in the salvo. However the missiles in the salvo cannot be guided.
overclocks.effectZh: ▲ 同时发射至多 9 枚飞弹；▲ 根据已填装的飞弹数增加额外伤害；▼ 齐射的飞弹无法被引导

overclocks.nameEn: A bit on the larger side, but with a few modifications to the weapon you can now use the most powerful power source R&D could smuggle back from the black market. The extra energy boosts rate of fire and total ammo at the cost of a lower cooldown and longer unjam duration.
overclocks.effectZh: ▲ 提高射速；▲ 相当多的弹药；▼ 降低冷却速率；▼ 更慢的过热后恢复时间

overclocks.nameEn: A lens add-on that focuses the microwaves significantly, enhancing their damage output for up to 4 meters.
overclocks.effectZh: ▲ 增加近距离伤害
▲ 有几率对敌人造成放射性污染；▼ 备弹量和伤害减少；▼ 大幅减小作用范围
▲ 微波可贯穿更多敌人；▲ 命中敌人时使其减速；▼ 降低造成的伤害

overclocks.nameEn: Adding an experimental electron tube makes the microwaves generate more heat, boiling the skin of enemies in the shape of large blisters. The blisters bypass armor, enhances incoming direct damage and hurts the target when popped. The large amounts of heat generated comes at the price of a lower cooldown rate.
overclocks.effectZh: ▲ 有几率在敌人身上熔出弱点；▼ 每次射击产生更多热量；▼ 降低冷却速率

overclocks.nameEn: Extremely efficient cooling system that helps the weapon generate slightly less heat, makes it cool faster and will spend less time jammed.
overclocks.effectZh: ▲ 加快冷却速率；▲ 过热后更快恢复；▼ 每次射击产生更少热量
▲ 换弹时引爆射入目标体内的微型炸药，造成大量伤害；▼ 显著减少备弹量；▼ 显著减少弹匣容量

overclocks.nameEn: Custom magazine that can fit a lot more ammo but it's a bit unwieldy and takes longer to reload.
overclocks.effectZh: ▲ 显著提升弹匣容量；▼ 更长的换弹时间

overclocks.nameEn: Any shot that hits a weakspot has a chance to ricochet into a nearby enemy.
overclocks.effectZh: ▲ 命中弱点的子弹将弹射到附近的敌人身上
▲ 射击模式变为全自动；▲ 显著提高射速；▼ 扩大基础散布；▼ 更强的后坐力

overclocks.nameEn: Part bullet, part syringe, these rounds are very effective at stunning most enemies and slowing down the rest.
overclocks.effectZh: ▼ 对大多数敌人造成更长时间的击晕和减速；▼ 降低射速；▼ 降低弹匣容量
▲ 每发造成 80% 至 140% 伤害
▲ 过热时造成大范围燃烧伤害；▲ 过热后更快恢复
▲ 显著提升伤害；▼ 扩大基础散布；▼ 每次射击产生更多热量；▼ 降低备弹量
▲ 发射物可以弹跳；▼ 降低射速

overclocks.nameEn: Adds fire damage and heat to projectiles for every 10% of heat generated over 50%
overclocks.effectZh: ▲ 武器积累热量高于 50% 时， 每增加 10% 热量都将提升等离子体附带的温度和火焰伤害；▼ 每次射击产生更多热量；▼ 更长过热持续时间

overclocks.nameEn: Applies temporary buff to Fire, Frost, and Electric damage on hit
overclocks.effectZh: ▲ 命中敌人将在短时间内增加其受到的燃烧、冻结、电击伤害；▼ 命中敌人将在短时间内降低其燃烧或冻结的阈值；▼ 降低造成的伤害；▼ 每次射击产生更多热量

overclocks.nameEn: More heat per shot and overheating collapses shield
overclocks.effectZh: ▲ 略微提高射速和电池容量；▲ 满护盾时显著提高发射物飞行速度和伤害；▼ 显著降低护盾充能延迟；▼ 每发射击产生更多的热量，武器过热将使护盾瓦解

overclocks.nameEn: By rewiring the thermal systems into a secondary cell and connecting it to the primary battery, your weapon can convert the energy from overheating into ammo. However this reduces the maximum capacity of the primary battery significantly.
overclocks.effectZh: ▲ 过热冷却期间回退弹药；▼ 更慢的过热后恢复时间；▼ 降低备弹量
▲ 加快冷却速率；▼ 每次射击产生更少热量
▲ 大幅提升伤害和精准度；▼ 大幅增加后坐力和每发散布；▼ 显著减少备弹量；▼ 换弹速度较慢的三发弹巢

overclocks.nameEn: Any shot that hits a weakspot has a high chance to ricochet into a nearby enemy.
overclocks.effectZh: ▲ 命中弱点的子弹将弹射到附近的敌人身上

overclocks.nameEn: An updated casing profile lets you squeeze 2 more rounds into the cylinder and take a few more rounds with you, but all that filing and drilling has compromised the accuracy of the weapon and it takes longer to reload.
overclocks.effectZh: ▲ 射速更快的六发转轮；▲ 更多弹药；▼ 扩大基础散布；▼ 更长的换弹时间

overclocks.nameEn: Bullets ricochet off surfaces into nearby targets
overclocks.effectZh: ▲ 命中岩体的子弹将弹跳射中附近目标；▲ 更多弹药；▼ 显著减少伤害

overclocks.nameEn: Deal massive fire damage to burning targets
overclocks.effectZh: ▲ 对点燃目标造成额外燃烧伤害；▼ 显著减少直接伤害
▲ 最高造成 200% 伤害；▼ 最低造成 75% 伤害
▲ 大幅提升伤害；▼ 显著减少备弹量；▼ 更长的换弹时间
▲ 同时射出两发霰弹；▲ 极大地提升冲击波的伤害

overclocks.nameEn: Less like gunpowder and more like rocketfuel, this mixture gives a hell of a kick that you can use to get places.
overclocks.effectZh: ▲ 利用霰弹枪的冲击将自己推向空中
▲ 每发霰弹射出更多弹丸；▲ 略微提升伤害
▲ 更多弹药；▲ 更快的换弹速度
▲ 显著缩小基础散布；▼ 略微减少备弹量

overclocks.nameEn: Electrified sentries work as nodes in an electric arc
overclocks.effectZh: ▲ 射击平台和炮台将使其通电；▲ 通电炮台可作为电弧节点；▼ 降低射速；▼ 降低备弹量
▲ 显著提高射速；▲ 子弹附加电击伤害；▼ 扩大基础散布
▲ 显著缩小基础散布；▲ 提高弱点伤害；▼ 很大的后坐力；▼ 降低弹匣容量
▲ 提高射速；▲ 更快的换弹速度

overclocks.nameEn: Shoot a turret to trigger a large electrical discharge
overclocks.effectZh: ▲ 射击炮台将使炮台进行一次大型放电；▼ 降低造成的伤害；▼ 略微减少弹匣容量
▲ 相当多的弹药；▼ 降低射速；▼ 略微减少伤害

overclocks.nameEn: Same power but in a smaller package giving slightly better accuracy and letting you fit a few more rounds in each magazine.
overclocks.effectZh: ▲ 提升弹匣容量；▲ 缩小基础散布
